Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

grid=[[9]*19 for _ in range(28)]
pts=[(2,4),(2,15),(3,4),(4,4),(6,4),(6,15),(8,4),(9,4),(10,15),(12,15),(13,4),(17,4),(18,15),(19,4),(23,4),(23,5),(23,6),(23,7),(23,11)]
for r,c in pts:grid[r][c]=8
def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    cells=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==8]
    r0=min(r for r,c in cells);r1=max(r for r,c in cells);c0=min(c for r,c in cells);c1=max(c for r,c in cells)
    for c in range(c0,c1+1):
        for r in (r0,r1):

    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        for c in (c0,c1):

    return out
